label: Updated at 8 a.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Michael Brennan leads Wyndham
items.text: Michael Brennan and Beau Hossler move near the lead at 16-under in the final round of the Wyndham Championship, with Tom Kim close behind at 15-under.

items.headline: Brooks Koepka FedEx Cup Risk
items.text: Brooks Koepka needs to move into the FedEx Cup top 70 at the Wyndham Championship to qualify for the FedEx St. Jude Championship next week.

items.headline: Scheffler Skips Wyndham
items.text: Scottie Scheffler is skipping the Wyndham Championship after a solid 2026 season, preparing for the upcoming FedEx Cup Playoffs.
